summary.headline: Finger Inc. subsidiary FG Investment No. 2 approves KRW 60.3bn rights offering, fully subscribed by parent
summary.what_happened: On Nov 26, 2026, the board of Finger Inc.'s subsidiary FG Investment No. 2 (주식회사 에프지투자2호) approved a rights offering of 603,483 common shares at KRW 100,000 per share, allocated to shareholders at a ratio of 60.3483 new shares per existing share. Finger Inc., the sole shareholder, will subscribe to all of the new shares, and payment will be made by offsetting a loan receivable from the subsidiary against the subscription obligation.
summary.why_it_matters: In Korea, rights offerings by a subsidiary generally involve existing shareholders being offered new shares in proportion to their holdings, and they can change a company's share capital and capital structure. Where the parent company subscribes in full, as stated here, the offering mainly affects the subsidiary's internal capital and debt arrangements rather than outside shareholders.
